query: Which targeted outreach strategies, sampling quotas, trusted intermediaries, and logistics will best reach older adults, wheelchair users, caregivers and other hard-to-reach groups to avoid selection bias?

response.query: Which targeted outreach strategies, sampling quotas, trusted intermediaries, and logistics will best reach older adults, wheelchair users, caregivers and other hard-to-reach groups to avoid selection bias?
response.answer: Use targeted outreach through community centers, social media, and local organizations; set inclusive sampling quotas; engage trusted local advocates; and ensure accessible logistics to reach older adults, wheelchair users, caregivers, and other hard-to-reach groups.

results.content: (U)      Up to ten percent of any funds appropriated for State Aid to Classrooms at the end of the fiscal year may be carried forward into the subsequent fiscal year and allocated to school districts, the South Carolina Public Charter School District, and an institution of higher education that authorizes charter schools pursuant to this provision. The cost for educating such children shall be allocated in the following manner:  the school district where the child last resided before being placed in an institution shall pay to the school district providing the educational services an amount equivalent to the statewide average of the local base student cost multiplied by the appropriate pupil weighting as set forth in Section 59-20-40 of the Education Finance Act; the school district providing the educational services shall be able to count the child for all funding sources, both state and federal.
